pairs.name: Pudge
pairs.reason: Pudge Support can pickup an early Aghanim's Shard in order to save his allies from Frost Blast - Dismembered allies do not heal but also do not have their health reduced in any way allowing them to wait out the Frost Blast debuff duration in safety. Meat Hook is effective at pulling teammates away from Cold Feet's stun radius.

pairs.name: Storm Spirit
pairs.reason: Storm's mobility allows him to easily get on top of AA and has enough damage to kill him reliably. Ball of Lightning allows him to easily dodge Ice Blast and get away from Cold Feet in order to dispel it. Ball of Lihgtning can also disjoint any Chilling Touch hits and makes retreating back to safety easy for Storm.

pairs.name: Lycan
pairs.reason: Lycan's mobility allows him to easily get on top of AA and has enough damage to kill him reliably. Shapeshift essentially provides him with Haste making it difficult for AA to connect his Ice Blast and easy for Lycan to leave Cold Feet's stun radius. Summon Wolves on their own are able to apply enough pressure for AA and force him to kite them.

pairs.name: Anti-Mage
pairs.reason: AA's quite mana intensive due to the low cooldowns of his spells, which makes him a great target for Mana Void. Blink is amazing for both closing the gap and dodging/disengaging Ice Blast or Cold Feet. Counterspell can block/reflect Cold Feet and provides Magic Resistance to significantly mitigate AA's exclusive magic damage output.

pairs.name: Medusa
pairs.reason: Medusa's Mana Shield is essentially her HP bar, which makes her the perfect counter to Ice Blast as it does not affect mana regeneration in any way, completely rendering the impact of the spell to only a fraction of it. Manta and Butterly are staple items for Medusa, with which she can Dispel Cold Feet and Evade Chilling Touch hits.

pairs.name: Weaver
pairs.reason: Shukuchi allows Weaver to easily get on top of AA or to disengage from Cold Feet or Ice Blast. Time Lapse is able to restore HP during Ice Blast as it does not function as a heal and can be further upgraded with Aghanim's Scepter to save allies. Additionally, Time Lapse can dispel Cold Feet and Shukuchi can disjoint the occasional Chilling Touch hit.

pairs.name: Night Stalker
pairs.reason: Night Stalker counters Ancient Apparition with his high mobility and silence, limiting AA’s ability to cast Ice Blast and other spells.

pairs.name: Brewmaster
pairs.reason: Brewmaster is good against Ancient Apparition because his Primal Split can dodge Ice Blast and avoid its healing prevention. His strong stuns and disables can lock down AA before he casts spells.
